_about.source: every value from 3U: em_body00.bdd and em_status00.ems (the 3DS cart; the hit-zone values are byte-identical on both), read with layouts taken from 3U's own code (notes/hitzones-bdd.md, notes/hitzones-ems.md). Nothing from MHGU.
_about.tables: the .ems hit-zone table (S+0x14: 8 rows x 10 bytes), then the alternate table (S+0x18) where the file has one. A capsule's slot reads its own row of whichever table is active; the game switches a monster between them in its class code (`altWhen`). Columns, from the damage function 0x983ce4: c0 cut, c1 impact (weighted per weapon class), c2 shot (inferred: the column a projectile-flagged attack reads), c3-c7 fire/water/ice/thunder/dragon (the element skill ids), c8 stun, c9 exhaust.
_about.capsules: the .bdd records: [slot (+6 low byte), part (+8), shape (+4: 0 sphere at A on boneA, 1 capsule A..B on boneA, 2 A on boneA to B on boneB), boneA (+0), boneB (+2), radius (+0x10), A (+0x14), B (+0x20)], game units; the viewer scales by 0.01. Bone 1000 is the monster root, an id with no joint the model itself.
_about.capsuleFlags: the +0xa flag word: a normal attack never counts a shape with any of 0x2/0x10/0x40/0x100 (0x152); other attack types test their own bits. Those shapes are not baked.
_about.capsuleOff: the +0xc off-mask: the game skips the shape while info+0x8b6 & mask is set (bits 0x1-0x4 are set by severing a part; higher bits are per-class states). Not applied by the viewer yet.
_about.capsuleList: em025/em085 use a 69-record list in the executable unless info+0xdb == 1, so that list is shown.
_about.bin: <em>.bin: u32 primCount, primCount x u32 vertexCount, then one slot byte per vertex, then one part byte per vertex, in the order `prims` lists: the body's primitives (numeric keys, the viewer's primitive order), then each severable piece's ("<piece name>/<index>", baked against the body's capsules, since the game wears the piece on the body's joints until the cut).
_about.join: a drawn vertex takes the smallest containing capsule on the joint it is skinned to, else the smallest containing capsule, else the nearest, in bind pose; only shapes a normal attack counts.
_about.names: none: zones and parts are labelled by number until Raven names them.
